text:
maria: quick design check — putting this here before the sprint sync. the routing policies editor mock has a persistent toolbar on the left and a minimap/overview on the right. on narrow windows it looks cramped and the rule titles get truncated. here's the mock: https://mock.redwood/dev/rules-mini-map.png

jon: I noticed that too. on small widths the minimap steals vertical space. Can we collapse it into a toggle or an overlay? :thinking_face:

ashley: +1 on a toggle. but for simulation/preview flows we still want a quick legend visible. maybe a tiny compact legend above the canvas that expands into the full minimap when clicked.

kevin: accessibility note — the minimap isn't keyboard-focusable in the mock. If we keep it persistent we need `role=\"region\" aria-label=\"Policy overview\"` and keyboard controls to jump to sections. also needs clear focus styles.

sam: usability/validation thing: when a rule fails validation in the preview, currently we show a transient toast. super easy to miss. propose inline error badges attached to the offending rule card and a persistent banner in the toolbar until fixed.

maria: good call. inline errors + a condensed banner would help. also thinking about the drag handle for priority ordering — right now it's purely drag-only. keyboard users can't reorder. we should add visible "Move up" / "Move down" actions on focus (visibly hidden until focus).

jon: agreed on move buttons. they can be small icon buttons with `aria-hidden=false` when the card is focused and exposed to screen readers. fallback: expose a context menu with reorder actions.

ashley: copy tweak: the current preview label says "Simulate traffic" — suggests a generative sim. replace with "Run routing simulation" and add a short tooltip: "Preview how traffic will be routed with current rules." keeps expectation clear.

kevin: also suggest add focus order tests in the QA checklist: toolbar -> canvas -> minimap -> inspector. right now the mock jumps from toolbar to inspector, skipping canvas controls.

sam: small nit on colors — error state uses red 500 but contrast fails with some labels. bump to red 700 for WCAG AA on 14px text.

maria: love all of this. next steps: ashley can prototype compact legend + toggle; kevin and jon can add keyboard/focus annotations; sam will draft updated validation flows and error copy; i'll update the mock and follow-up with screenshots in this thread. :thumbsup:

design-bot: Added task to #design-queue: "policy-editor — minimap accessibility + compact legend" (EPIC-3421).

jon: one more UX thought — when dragging a rule the minimap currently redraws and shifts the viewport. can we freeze the minimap during drag or show a subtle ghost instead? it's disorienting.

ashley: freeze minimap during drag sounds right. or throttle updates to once per 300ms. we'll prototype both.

maria: thanks team. i'll post an updated mock by EOD with the aria attributes and the copy tweaks for review.

kevin: ping me when it's up, i'll run a quick a11y pass.

sam: and i'll add the validation samples to the preview harness so we can test error persistence across reruns.

maria: cool — closing thread for now, will reopen with the new screens.
